messages:
Maria G.: starting a quick probe for customer Kyros - merging their LoRA into 7B-int4 variant. seeing weird tokenization mismatch on a handful of prompts, filing here. TL;DR: sometimes outputs drop expected entity tokens.
Cheng L.: thanks — can you paste the exact merge command / config? which tokenizer/vocab are they using?
Maria G.: sure, running:```bash
python merge_lora.py --base-model redwood/7b-int4 --lora kyros/lora-v2 --out=kyros-7b-int4-merged --quantize int4 --keep-tokenizer 
```
Maria G.: tokenizer is kyros-token-v1 (custom vocab, +10k tokens). I left `--keep-tokenizer` on purpose to keep mapping.
Taylor R.: quick smoke results: ran ~120 prompts from kyros QA set.
Taylor R.: metrics snapshot: exact-match down 3.4% vs non-quantized merged; hallucination cases up on dates/times. PPL delta +0.9.
Natalie (QA): can you paste one failing example? helps triage.
Maria G.: example: prompt: "List the next 3 maintenance windows for AcmeCorp"
Maria G.: expected: "2025-03-01 02:00 UTC, 2025-03-08 02:00 UTC, 2025-03-15 02:00 UTC"
Maria G.: model returned: "March 1st, March 8th, and March 15th" (ok) but another: tokenized single string sometimes becomes "20250301" which downstream parser fails on.
Cheng L.: hmm looks like tokenizer merges numeric tokens into single unknown token under quantized kernels. do we have token offsets from the merged tokenizer?
Maria G.: attaching quick log snippet:```
input_ids: [102, 5784, 90021, 30002, 14, 90021, 999]
decoded: ["2025-03-01", "20250301"]
```
Cheng L.: odd — maybe our byte-pair merges align differently once LoRA weights change embedding space. Could be tied to tokenizer special-casing.
Taylor R.: I re-ran same pack but with `--force-recompute-embeddings` after merge, EM drop reduced to 1.1%. PPL back to +0.2.
Maria G.: good call. can we make that a standard step in the onboarding script? feels cheap fix but need to confirm perf impact.
Natalie (QA): regression test: add a small suite for numeric parsing + date formats. I can add 50 golden prompts.
Maria G.: will add to eval pack. also testing a variant: keep original tokenizer but run post-merge a token remapping step that normalizes numeric spans -> doing now.
serve-bot: deploy started: kyros-7b-int4-merged (canary) -> gw-12 at 2025-03-12T18:22:10Z
Taylor R.: canary results (50 queries): EM delta -0.8% vs baseline, latency +1.5ms. Nice.
Cheng L.: next action: add `--force-recompute-embeddings` to pipeline, add numeric-normalization tests, and run a full 1k prompt sweep. assign owners?
Maria G.: I'll own pipeline change. Natalie you own test set. Cheng you run the 1k sweep and share notebook.
Natalie (QA): ack, adding tests now. ETA EOD. :white_check_mark:
Cheng L.: planning sweep early tomorrow, will post results in this thread.
Maria G.: nice work team, keeping Kyros onboarding tight. tagging @taylor for perf review when full sweep done. :thumbsup:
